#.label: POS buttons and layout (preview)
#.description: Checkout App POS menu layout. Defines menu trees per application type, mode and function
#/properties/menuTrees.label: Menu lists
#/properties/menuTrees.description: Menu lists available to the Checkout App. Each list is a hierarchy of groups and items.
#/properties/menuTrees/items/properties/: A unique identifier for the Menu.
Where in the app the given list is displayed.
The number of columns to render the menu list in. If not set, the menu list will be rendered in 2 columns.
The application types that can access the Menu list.
Regular POS application. Desktop or Tablet POS
Self checkout application. Hybrid or dedicated self checkout application
Self checkout application while attendant is logged in
The checkout engine mode required to access the Menu list. This menu is shown when the till is in this mode.
The action to perform when the Menu item is selected. Catalogue actions pick a category and type. Custom commands set category command plus the Checkout Engine command name.
Background color of the button. Default is the store theme. The till picks black or white text to stay readable. Inapplicable to root groups.
Grid span. Wide takes two columns, tall two rows, large both.
menuTreesIntro.text: Each list is a hierarchy of groups and items. Select any menu list, group or item on the left to edit it on the right, or use the toolbar buttons to add new entries into the focused folder.
